title: Ecosystem-based adaptation and small-scale water retention
claim: Small-scale water-retention structures such as farm ponds and contour trenches help capture irregular rainfall for use during dry periods, reducing drought stress on vegetation and soil organisms.
evidence_text: UNEP's ecosystem-based adaptation guidance recommends small-scale water-harvesting infrastructure — farm ponds, check dams, and contour trenches — as low-cost measures to capture rainfall during wet periods and make it available during dry spells. This is highlighted as increasingly important where rainfall is becoming more irregular and temperatures are rising, both of which increase soil moisture deficits between rain events.
